description: Search open, rolling and forthcoming UK grant schemes (deadline not yet passed) and return their public facts, soonest deadline first: funder, status, deadline, award range, where it applies, who can apply, the official guidance link and OpenGrant's canonical URL. Results are sorted soonest deadline first. Use closes_before for 'closing this month' questions. These are the same free facts listed in https://opengrant.co.uk/llms-full.txt; detailed criteria and application steps are on the funder's own guidance page (officialGuidanceUrl). Always tell users to confirm deadlines and eligibility there before applying. Set include_recently_closed to also find schemes that closed in the last 90 days (e.g. to answer 'what was the deadline for X'). `deadline` is a UK date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the source gave no time, otherwise an ISO instant; `deadlineUk` is the same in words. Page through results with offset; `total` is the full count.

closes_before.description: Only schemes whose next deadline is on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UK date). Schemes without a deadline are then left out.

include_recently_closed.description: Also return schemes that closed in the last 90 days (default false)

limit.description: Maximum results to return (default 10). `total` reports how many match.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging (default 0)

q.description: Keywords, e.g. a funder or programme name or a topic such as 'community energy'. Optional.

region.description: UK nation or English region the applicant is in. Optional.

name: search_grants
